date_evidence.timezone_basis: Original @timestamp UTC Z; website alone does not specify timezone

attack_window_registration.input: Scoring-side official labels.entries metadata: source, host, timestamp, label=malicious (class_1)
attack_window_registration.order: Ascending UTC class_1 timestamp; input label order has no effect
attack_window_registration.next: A timestamp inside the preceding registered window creates no new candidate; timestamp>=end starts the next window
attack_window_registration.boundary: Exclude and record registered candidates crossing the test period boundary; retain outside-test candidates with an explicit reason
attack_window_registration.normal: UTC half-hour grid; exclude every grid window intersecting a registered attack candidate before seed-42 selection of one reliable benign window per source/host/UTC day
attack_window_registration.projection: Earliest 100 unique observations by observed_at,external_id within the host window; labels never reorder or prioritize projected evidence
attack_window_registration.accounting: Every parsed row contributes once to full-scan statistics and independently to each matching grid/registered window; every candidate is selected or excluded with a reason
attack_window_registration.ablation: Use the same eligible test cases, M_D=N_D; no repeated slices to fill a target count

overlap_policy: nonoverlapping registered attack windows per source/host; overlapping grid candidates excluded; cross-host same campaign correlated

preregistration_revision.reason: Register input-observable attack candidate windows before any formal case selection; earliest-100 UTC grid projection can hide sparse class_1 evidence in benign background
preregistration_revision.scope_change: None: fixed 1800 seconds, one source/host, at most 100 records, alert at midpoint with +/-900-second scope
